blocks.rationale: Install a joint package that directly addresses all three trigger failures: a baggage calculator with separately readable checked-position fees and per-position weight allowances, plus a progressive-tax subclause classifier that verifies both bracket applicability and the claimed amount. The baggage helper also preserves or improves the airline history case.

inputs.question: What is the current passenger's integer ticket price?

inputs.name: lengths

inputs.name: widths

inputs.question: What ordered length, width, and height limits apply to one personal item under the current source?

inputs.name: carryon_limits
inputs.question: What ordered length, width, and height limits apply to one carry-on bag under the current source?

inputs.name: first_checked_fee
inputs.question: For the current itinerary and cabin, what is the numeric base fee for the first checked bag?

inputs.name: second_checked_fee

inputs.name: third_checked_fee

inputs.name: weight_limits_by_checked_position
inputs.question: For each current checked-bag position, what standard weight limit applies after accounting for whether that position is complimentary and for the passenger's cabin? Expand the list through every current checked bag.

inputs.name: overweight_upper_bounds
inputs.question: For the current route, what ascending weight upper bounds cover the standard and applicable overweight bands? Include the no-overweight-fee standard band so this array aligns one-to-one with overweight_fees.

inputs.name: overweight_fees

inputs.name: size_upper_bounds
inputs.question: For the current route, what ascending total-dimension upper bounds cover the standard and applicable oversize bands? Include the no-oversize-fee standard band so this array aligns one-to-one with size_fees.

inputs.name: size_fees
inputs.question: What numeric fee corresponds to each total-dimension band in size_upper_bounds, including zero for the standard band?

skill.intent: Compute the exact ticket-plus-bag-fee total by classifying cabin items, assigning checked-bag position fees, and applying the higher applicable overweight or oversize fee to each checked bag.

outputs.description: The exact current ticket price plus all applicable checked-bag, overweight, and oversize fees.
outputs.name: answer

reads.question: Jointly read the current passenger's ordered item measurements and ticket price and the current source's cabin-item limits, checked-position fees, position-specific weight allowances, and route-specific excess-fee bands.
reads.source_locator: current facts, question, and baggage-fee source

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Use at most one qualifying personal-item position and one qualifying carry-on position; treat the remaining current items as checked bags.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Determine a checked bag's size by summing its three outside dimensions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher excess fee to its checked-position fee.

origin.quote: For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags

source_obligations.statement: Apply the source's cabin- and complimentary-status-specific weight allowance separately to each checked-bag position.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

skill.intent: Determine whether a claimed tax amount attributed to a specified progressive-tax subclause follows from the taxpayer's current filing status, taxable income, and the current statutory bracket schedule.

outputs.description: The current native binary label: Entailment if the expressly invoked bracket applies and yields the claimed tax amount, otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

reads.question: Read the current taxpayer's filing status and taxable income, the tax amount and numbered subclause asserted by the proposition, and the complete progressive schedule for that asserted filing status.
reads.source_locator: current statutory source, referenced sections, facts, and question

origin.quote: $2,767.50, plus 28% of the excess over $18,450 if the taxable income is over $18,450 but not over $44,575

source_obligations.statement: Identify the bracket whose stated income interval contains the current taxable income before applying its formula.

origin.quote: (iii) $10,082.50, plus 31% of the excess over $44,575 if the taxable income is over $44,575 but not over $70,000

source_obligations.statement: The proposition is entailed only if its expressly cited numbered bracket is the applicable bracket for the current income and filing status.

origin.quote: 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $18,450

source_obligations.statement: Apply the fixed base and marginal rate of the applicable bracket to determine whether it yields the proposition's claimed tax amount.

source_provenance.quote: There is hereby imposed on the taxable income of every married individual (as defined in section 7703) who does not make a single return jointly with his spouse, a tax determined in accordance with the following:
(i) 15% of taxable income if the taxable income is not over $18,450;
(iii) $10,082.50, plus 31% of the excess over $44,575 if the taxable income is over $44,575 but not over $70,000;
